questions.subject: PHYSICS_I
questions.learningObjective: Compute momentum in a real scenario
questions.stem: Log: a 0.5 kg finder scope moves at 2 m/s; its momentum?

options.text: 0.25 kg m/s, dividing mass by speed
2.5 kg m/s, adding mass and speed
1 kg m/s from mass times velocity

options.misconception: squares speed instead of using mass

questions.explanation: Momentum = mass times velocity = 0.5*2 = 1 kg m/s. Adding, dividing, or squaring misapplies the definition.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_I
questions.learningObjective: Compute impulse in a real scenario
questions.stem: Log: 6 N on a dome for 4 s; impulse?

options.misconception: squares force instead of using time

options.text: 10 N s, adding force and time
1.5 N s, dividing force by time
24 N s from force times time

questions.explanation: Impulse = force times time = 6*4 = 24 N s. Adding, dividing, or squaring misapplies the definition.
